title: Mqryo's Tweaks
description: Extra Vanilla+ features to add some spice to every modpack!
body:
![Mqryo's Tweaks Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afa47402e8d7c5e11b02b718c742afa7ad19ab20.png)

![Mqryo's Tweaks Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3d5f2222bc040386f962e4ad5c6ce770372094f.png)

A collection of Items and Features to enhance every Modpack!

Version 1.0 features:
- **New Tools** & **Weapons**
- A **Paintbrush** item, to paint bricks with **dyes**!
- New Block Type: **The Tile**
- Retextured **Copper Tools** & **Armor**
- New and Improved **Diorite features**
- New **Andesite** Block
- New **Magma** & **Gilded Blackstone Bricks**

![Mqryo's Tweaks Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d4cbd919de0c6d9e0924aa9a24764e247523ed2.png)

With the new **Paintbrush**, you can use dyes to paint all Stone Bricks variants.
Simply right click the bricks with your Brush and the dye you prefer, and the job is done!

![Paintbrush Example 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/303d3f6e9e34e1765b4975361a78a194027546b2_0.webp)
